### What changed
Repo-root hygiene (gh-2185): every runtime-state file, log, and regenerable dump is out of git, the memory store consolidated to ONE home, docs/tool/goldens directories unified, the `${Directory.systemTemp.path}` artifact class guarded, and a root allow-list gate keeps the root clean.

### Key decisions
- **AC1** — all 7 app stores (cursors, pins, launcher layout, network mode, session prefs, onboarding, theme) now persist through a new seam `flutter_app/lib/services/app_state_paths.dart` → `<cwd>/.fah/state/<file>`; reads fall back to the legacy root path for one release (migration note). `git rm --cached chat_read_cursors.json launcher_layout.json network_mode.json logs/app.log`; `.gitignore` covers the class. UTs pin placement (state root, never cwd) + legacy migration per store.
- **AC2** — root `memory/` (921 files) moved to `.fah/memory/` (covered by `.fah/*` ignores); `.fah/config.yaml` drops the `./memory` pointer — `MemoryConfig` default resolves the same home (single resolvable root; `fa config check` green). AGENTS.md + memory docs re-pointed; notes stay local-only going forward.
- **AC3** — `/logs/`, `/memory/`, generated/profile dump classes gitignored; `git ls-files` shows zero `.log` files and only the allow-listed root JSONs.
- **AC4** — `flutter_app/test/golden/` + `test/goldens/` merged into ONE `flutter_app/test/goldens/` (566 files; store pngs now at `test/goldens/store/`, reached via a shorter relative path). Consumers re-pointed: `check_goldens.py` constants/run cmd, ci.yml + nightly.yml + golden-regen.yml, `ci_fast_gate.sh`/ci.yml find exclusions, `golden_guard_test.dart` map, AGENTS.md + 5 docs, fastlane comments, `cli_visual` relative imports, `crap4dart.yaml`. PNG bytes untouched (pure `git mv`); pixel baselines stay macOS-owned (`flutter-app-goldens` job).
- **AC5** — `goal/*.md` → `docs/goals/` (every doc-comment pointer updated, incl. the copilot-provider card referenced from `lib/src/providers`); `knowledgebase/` → `docs/knowledgebase/` (verdict: **moved**, all 10 dated note dirs; zero deletions). `sdk/web` **kept** — justified: it is the wire-protocol reference client gated by `test/wire/web_client_conformance_test.dart` (node conformance runner); renaming it would break the conformance hook for zero hygiene gain. `store_artefacts/` **kept** — store-metadata changelogs consumed by the store pipeline (`docs/agents/commits-releases.md` §141). `CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md` **kept at root** — release tooling/tests read it there (`test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart`, `test/publish_staging_test.dart`).
- **AC6** — traced: no shipped writer produces literal `${...}` names (repo-wide grep: only real `Directory.systemTemp` API uses in Dart; the empty literal dir came from an agent-run bash command quoting a Dart expression). Guard added instead: any root entry named like an unexpanded `${...}` fails `scripts/check_root_allowlist.py` (self-tested, incl. the exact `${Directory.systemTemp.path}` fixture); the artifact itself is already absent from the tree.
- **AC7** — `scripts/check_root_allowlist.py`: every tracked depth-0 entry must be in the KEEP allow-list; wired into pre-commit (`ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_analyze) + the CI `static` job; wiring pinned by `test/root_allowlist_guard_test.dart`. Allow-list additions require a card-visibility review (message says so).
- **AC9** — `tools/` + `tool/` → ONE `tool/` (crap_top.sh + fa-clip); `build_fa_clip.sh`, AGENTS.md, sdk-subsystems.md, fa_clip_helper_test, flutter_app README updated; compiled fa-clip binary gitignored.
- **AC10** — theme.json writer joins the state root (`.fah/state/`); NOTE: the addendum suggested `~/.fah/themes/`, but the CLI TUI theme loader parses EVERY `~/.fah/themes/*.json` as a role palette (`lib/src/cli/tui_theme.dart`) — the app-prefs envelope there would error every CLI boot, so the state/themes home is `.fah/state/` (packs stay at `themes/<id>/`). Root `theme.json` copy absent → nothing to delete. `test-results/` reporters/uploads/consumers (ci.yml 17 sites, nightly 8, gate script) moved under gitignored `build/test-results/`.
- **AC11** — yoclip binaries out of git, per-class: **untracked** 4 WAV masters (14.1 MB; regenerable via `tools/build_audio.sh` + `build_music_v2.sh` — macOS `say`+ffmpeg), 10 V1-dead device crops `en_*/ru_*` (2.7 MB; derived from the committed `flutter_app/test/goldens/store` shots; the V1 scenes using them are config-dead), 5 unreferenced promo masters (1.2 MB). **kept** 16 m4a (~2.1 MB; mux-time inputs, incl. `render_all_v2.sh`'s `music_v2.m4a`), 3 GLB + texture (0.55 MB; game-scene render-bearing), 7 promo crops/icon referenced by `yoclip.yaml external_assets`. Tracked yoclip binaries: 46 → 27; tracked payload ~22.6 MB → ~3.1 MB. No LFS (repo has none; regen scripts + committed derivations cover rebuilds). `yoclip/README.md` names it the fa promo-video workspace. `.pubignore` `/yoclip/` keeps all of it out of the package. Clone size unchanged by design (no history rewrite — documented non-goal; pack 143.47 MiB).
- **AC12** — `docs/vendor.md`: the KEEP rationale for `vendor/` (patched forks) + `pubspec_overrides.yaml` (the deliberate vendor switch that never ships to pub.dev); indexed in `docs/README.md`.
- **AC8** — fast gate green locally (analyze, test-core, coverage, CRAP, dup, dupx, flutter, integration-mock); `check_goldens.py --quick` green; `dart pub publish --dry-run` clean (payload unchanged: `/docs/` + `/yoclip/` were already excluded); memory/publish/changelog test pins green.

### How to verify

python3 scripts/check_root_allowlist.py --self-test && python3 scripts/check_root_allowlist.py

dart test test/root_allowlist_guard_test.dart test/docs_link_check_test.dart

### What changed
Repo-root hygiene (gh-2185): every runtime-state file, log, and regenerable dump is out of git, the memory store consolidated to ONE home, docs/tool/goldens directories unified, the `${Directory.systemTemp.path}` artifact class guarded, and a root allow-list gate keeps the root clean.

### Key decisions
- **AC1** — all 7 app stores (cursors, pins, launcher layout, network mode, session prefs, onboarding, theme) now persist through a new seam `flutter_app/lib/services/app_state_paths.dart` → `<cwd>/.fah/state/<file>`; reads fall back to the legacy root path for one release (migration note). `git rm --cached chat_read_cursors.json launcher_layout.json network_mode.json logs/app.log`; `.gitignore` covers the class. UTs pin placement (state root, never cwd) + legacy migration per store.
- **AC2** — root `memory/` (921 files) moved to `.fah/memory/` (covered by `.fah/*` ignores); `.fah/config.yaml` drops the `./memory` pointer — `MemoryConfig` default resolves the same home (single resolvable root; `fa config check` green). AGENTS.md + memory docs re-pointed; notes stay local-only going forward. Documented follow-up (non-goal here): `chat_read_cursors.json` carries a personal email + session ids in git HISTORY — no history rewrite on a public repo; rotating/invalidating those cursors is a suggested follow-up card.
